subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: What public reset-start policy should OpenClaw expose for bare `/new` and `/reset` across static acknowledgements, startup/model turns, prompt text, greeting suppression, and optional cheaper greeting-model routing?
rationale: The remaining work adds compatibility-sensitive config and changes reset/session-start and provider/model routing semantics, so automation should not invent the key shape or default behavior.

options.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Add a typed policy that keeps defaults explicit and covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing without separate competing knobs.

options.title: Keep Acknowledgement Default
options.body: Preserve current cheap acknowledgement behavior and expose startup/model greeting only as an explicit opt-in policy.

options.title: Defer New Reset Controls
options.body: Leave current behavior and use the prompt-text and fallthrough discussions until maintainers approve a broader reset contract.

recommendation.title: Define One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Add a typed policy that keeps defaults explicit and covers startup turns, prompt text, suppression, and greeting-model routing without separate competing knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current acknowledgement contract and the prior policy review, making it the best available owner for the default/config decision.
